source.title: Riemann domains: basic results and open problems

trace.notes: Normalized the single input as a zbMATH bibliographic resolver URL with trailing identifier 3440801. Local resolver metadata identified the exact work as Martin Schottenloher, "Riemann domains: basic results and open problems," Lecture Notes in Mathematics 364, pages 196-212, 1974, with DOI 10.1007/BFb0069019 and Springer chapter URL https://link.springer.com/chapter/10.1007/BFb0069019.

Classified the access failure as metadata_only with network_or_dns_failure in the local shell. Local curl could not resolve zbmath.org, link.springer.com, api.zbmath.org, or oai.zbmath.org; browser/page-reader attempts for the zbMATH URL, DOI landing page, Springer chapter, Springer PDF pattern, zbMATH API/OAI, and exact-title searches did not expose a readable PDF or full HTML source containing the problem statements.

Rejected recovered candidates because they were resolver metadata, table-of-contents entries, references from later papers, search snippets, or unrelated works. The workflow forbids extracting open problems from metadata, citations, snippets, or different works when the primary technical source text is unavailable.
Saved exact JSON output to outputs/parse-paper/3440801.json and updated outputs/latest.json.
